author: Logos V
title: Logos V: SOTA Validation v2 (Hybrid Embedding+Graph)
abstract: Correcting the failure of the first validation attempt (ID 736). That version produced only a graph, causing multiple metrics to fail. This version is a hybrid: it uses the graph construction method from Archive #24 combined with the embedding generation pipeline from the original SOTA submission (ID 609). This should produce a complete output and correctly replicate the ~0.734 score.
